description: Weekly dependency updates, only to versions published at least 30 days ago (same rule as minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml), security fixes included. The weekly audit job (.github/workflows/audit.yml) catches advisories Renovate cannot fix, e.g. in transitive dependencies.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for every stable minor/patch update. 0.x minors can break, so they keep their own PRs.
Electron ships the whole runtime: its own PR, verified with the e2e suite and a packaged-app smoke test.
Native modules are rebuilt against Electron's ABI: their own PR.

Patched in patches/ (package.json pnpm.patchedDependencies, keyed by exact version): a bump needs the patch re-ported, so approve it from the Dependency Dashboard. electron-builder is here because it pins the patched app-builder-lib.
TypeScript and React are exempt from the 30-day minimum release age (pnpm-workspace.yaml minimumReleaseAgeExclude): always the latest version.
